text: Active inference extends predictive processing from perception to action by proposing that an organism minimizes prediction error not only by updating its internal model but also by:
choices: Acting on the world to make sensory input conform to its predictions
Endlessly increasing the complexity of its generative model
Storing prediction errors so they can be reviewed consciously later
Broadcasting its prediction errors to neighboring organisms
explanation: In active inference, action fulfills predictions by changing the organism's relationship to the world, so perception and action become two routes to the same free-energy-minimizing goal. Goals are treated as predictions about desired states. Growing the model without limit is penalized by the complexity term of free energy, and neither conscious review nor broadcasting errors is part of the framework.
